method: Two 10-turn chats. Each path makes one seed call on turn one and one update call per later turn. The strong-seed paths use GPT-6.1 Sol for turn one, then GPT-4.1 nano or Jev for turns two through ten. Each path is scored on all 20 turns. Belief snapshots and the new message are sent on every update. Costs include all calls, including the two strong seed calls where applicable. No settled-field omission is used in this test.
price_basis: Published Standard text list rates on 2026-10-16: GPT-6.1 Sol $2 input, $0.10 cached, $2.50 writes, $10 output per 1M; GPT-4.1 nano $0.10 input, $0.025 cached, $0.40 output per 1M; Jev $0.042 input per 1M, output free. USD estimates exclude local storage, taxes, and service-tier variation.
token_note: Provider token counts are included for audit, but Jev and OpenAI use different token accounting and should not be compared as a common unit.
